review.tagline: Self-hosted workspace for chat, agents, email, documents, notes and calendar
review.summary: Odysseus is a self-hosted web workspace that combines chat with local or API models, tool-using agents, deep research, a document editor, an IMAP/SMTP email client, and notes with CalDAV calendar sync. Agents can use MCP, files, shell, skills and memory. A model cookbook recommends, downloads and serves models based on the host hardware.
review.audience: Self-hosters wanting one workspace for chat, agents, mail and documents
strengths: Covers chat, email, documents, notes and CalDAV calendar in one app
Agents support MCP, shell, files, skills and memory
Built-in blind side-by-side model comparison and multi-step deep research
Compose file pulls a prebuilt multi-arch image from ghcr.io
weaknesses: Ships local shell and file tools; auth must stay enabled when exposed
Default branch is dev; the more curated branch is main
AGPL-3.0 license restricts closed-source network use
RAM and VRAM requirements are not stated in the README
needs: Models: local models, API models, MCP
